posts.author: JohnFP
posts.content_md: I guess you mean that space age stuff developed by NASA and sold as bedding? I have not but I bet that stuff would be good. I mean, a glass of liquid does not move when jumping on the bed, so the commercial goes. Talk about dampening.

posts.author: MichaelH
posts.content_md:
My suspicion is that it wouldn't work very well just because it compresses so easily. It seems to me that if you put it under a table, all of the material would be squashed into a fairly thin mass of foam and lose most of its damping properties.

On the other hand, if I had enough of it I'd still give it a shot to see what happens.

posts.author: JohnFP
posts.content_md: Michael, I was thinking it could be used for a light but very rigid table. Something like an industrial steel door as Danny suggested for a table top some time ago.
